args.title: Summary: Halvorsen freight pricing posts (2026)
args.body:
Combined summary of https://blog.halvorsen.example/2026/freight and its companion piece (https://insights.halvorsen.example/freight/companion):

• Spot freight rates fell 9% this quarter while contract rates held steady.
• Fuel surcharges now track weekly diesel prices.
• Shippers who split volume across three carriers paid the least.
